comment: Contract for the retained payload at `topic`: the [mqtt] section of LIB.MQTT/SRC/config.ini as the orchestrator publishes it (publish_protocol_configs: every ini value a JSON string, under value.mqtt). Readers: the shell (POD.THIN/OS/DataBus/config/bus-config.js: host, ws_port, tcp_port, public_host, public_ws_port, public_wss_port) and BrokerConfig::from_payload. Bump `version` and apkaudio_mqtt::CONFIG_PAYLOAD_VERSION together when a key in `keys` is renamed, removed or changes meaning.
